description: PSres is a power system resilience model that simulates the outage and restoration processes of a power system during an extreme weather event. It is built on the MATPOWER power system simulation library and the AC-CFM cascading failure simulator, with IPOPT as an optional solver for the cascading failure settings, and MATLAB R2022a or later is recommended. The authors, Aleksander Gerkis and Xiaozhe Wang, ask users to cite their 2025 IEEE Power and Energy Society General Meeting paper on probabilistic resilience assessment with the polynomial chaos expansion method. The code is free under the GNU GPL version 3 on GitHub, with installation by cloning the repository, and the last commit read was 17 April 2025. Coverage is any network available as a MATPOWER case. Caveats: it needs MATLAB and the AC-CFM and MATPOWER dependencies, the repository has no tagged releases, and validation cases are not described in the README. Simulation uses are Monte Carlo and surrogate-based assessment of weather-driven outages, cascading failures and restoration in transmission grids. Related records: model-matpower is the underlying simulation library.
